name: python-fastapi-postgres
title: Python + FastAPI + Postgres (SQLAlchemy, Alembic, uv, Docker)
summary: Python 3.12+ API service: FastAPI with Pydantic models at the boundary, SQLAlchemy 2.x (async or sync) over Postgres with Alembic migrations, pytest, ruff for lint and format, pyright (or mypy), uv for packages, a Docker image deployed to Fly.io, Railway, or Render, GitHub Actions CI.
recommended_for: a new API or backend service in Python where typed request contracts, a plain container deploy, and a migration graph the team controls by hand matter more than a batteries-included framework
not_for: admin-heavy CRUD apps (Django's admin and auth win), data pipelines, notebooks, or teams already committed to Django or Flask
package_manager: uv (pip fallback: uv export --format requirements-txt > requirements.txt, then pip install -r requirements.txt)

commands.migrate_prod: <scripts/migrate-prod.sh: verifies target host, prints pending revisions, demands typed confirmation, then alembic upgrade head>
commands.deploy: git push origin main (CI builds the image and deploys it on green; see WORKFLOW.md)

format_cmd: uv run ruff format (post-edit-format.sh detects ruff from pyproject.toml)
migration_tool: alembic (revision graph under alembic/versions/; watermark = the alembic_version table; exactly one head at all times)
date_helpers: app/core/dates.py (utc_now, today_local_iso, format_date); naive datetimes are the trap, ruff's DTZ rules catch them
app_verifier_boot: uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload (dev server on :8000; /docs lists every route), then drive the changed routes with curl or httpx

overlay.rules: rules/*.md replace the core api-boundary/data-layer/services/scripts rules; delete the core ui.md for an API-only service
